newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens networks to treble turnover by 2005.
newsitem.headline: Siemens networks to treble turnover by 2005.

text.p: The Siemens group's public networks division expects to treble turnover by the year 2005 to around 35 billion marks ($22.5 billion) a year, division chief Peter Pribilla told a news conference on Friday.
Pribilla also said he expected profits to improve both in the current business year and in 1997/98. Pre-tax profits rose 70 percent to 354 million marks in the latest year to September 30.
Despite the rapid growth, Pribilla said the public networks division would downsize its workforce by 1,000 by 1999 after finishing a digitalisation contract for Deutsche Telekom AG.
